messages:
Marta (partnerships): Quick heads-up — we shipped the new AWS + Azure marketplace metering adapters yesterday. Seeing a handful of customers with usage mismatches vs internal usage numbers. Anyone else seeing this in sandbox?
Samir (platform): I ran a few checks this morning. A couple patterns: Azure reports daily aggregates at UTC 00:00 whereas our collector emits hourly events in local region. That can skew per-day totals if we rollups differently.
Julia (billing): Noted. Also saw ~2% delta on one account where entitlements SKUs didn't map 1:1 — Azure sent a plan_code of `rwi_prod_v2` and our mapping expects `redwood-standard-v2`.
Marta (partnerships): Oof. Is that a mapping bug or product-side SKU rename that didn't land in the connector?
Samir (platform): Likely mapping. We have a mapping table in infra: `marketplace_sku_map` that is updated by partnerships. I didn't get the last PR. Quick fix might be an alias entry.
Raghav (si): Also worth calling out webhook delivery semantics. Azure can batch records into a single payload; AWS marketplace sometimes sends per-usage events. Our idempotency logic expects `event_id` top-level. But batched payloads currently don't include per-item IDs -> duplicates on retry.
Julia (billing): That's dangerous. We should require per-usage `id` or compute a deterministic idempotency key: `sha256(account + sku + hour)` for each line.
Samir (platform): Agree. Implementing deterministic keys is doable. Two caveats: (1) timezone normalization before hash, (2) consistent rounding of usage quantity.
Marta (partnerships): Good. Also we need to coordinate on backfills for affected customers — some invoices already closed. What's our reconciliation window?
Julia (billing): Finance will accept adjustments for the last 30 days if we have audited evidence. Beyond that becomes manual. So we should prioritise customers with closed invoices in 30-day window.
Raghav (si): For the partner side, I'd recommend we request partner to resend raw payloads for the affected dates. Azure has replay tools; AWS has metering reports you can request.
azure-partner-bot: Reminder: marketplace sandbox replay endpoint available at https://marketplace.partner/replay - supports `from_ts`/`to_ts` and `granularity=hour`.
Marta (partnerships): Thanks. Action items: 1) Samir add deterministic idempotency and timezone-normalization to the ingestion lambda (priority P0). 2) Julia assemble list of customers with invoice closed in last 30 days and delta > $1000. 3) Raghav request replay for those dates from partners.
Samir (platform): I'll open a PR with a small migration: compute `idempotency_key = sha256(customer_id + sku + iso_hour)` and store upstream. Also I'll add a lightweight QA script: `scripts/verify_marketplace_rollup.py` that compares our hourly rollup -> partner daily.
Julia (billing): I'll dump the account list to a shared spreadsheet and tag finance+cs. Link when ready.
Marta (partnerships): Also, we need to avoid changing production behavior silently — plan to ship the idempotency change behind a feature flag and enable in sandbox for 24h.
Samir (platform): Makes sense. Feature flag: `mp_ingest_deterministic_id` default off. Rolling enable for sandbox then staging then prod.
Raghav (si): For replay/backfill, if partner only gives daily aggregates we should run a reconciliation job that interpolates hourly vs daily but mark those backfills as "estimated" in audit trail.
Julia (billing): Any plan for notifying customers? We should pre-draft a short message for CS and a longer technical note for enterprise POCs.
Marta (partnerships): I'll draft the CS note. Simple language + link to technical appendix. Keep public comms minimal until we confirm root cause.
devops-bot: nightly-billing-worker started for 1765439200 -> processing marketplace deltas.
Samir (platform): One more gotcha I found: rate limits. Azure partner endpoints throttle after 120 req/min. For replay we should use exponential backoff and chunk requests to avoid 429s.
Raghav (si): I'll include throttling parameters in the replay request and ask partner to temporarily raise quota for the replay window.
Julia (billing): FYI, small discrepancy patterns: rounding of token counts when we charge per-1k tokens. If partner rounds per-report and we sum raw tokens before rounding we differ by a few cents per invoice but can compound.
Marta (partnerships): Good call. Add rounding rules to the integration spec: always keep raw usage in integer token counts, round only at billing line level using banker's rounding.
Samir (platform): I'll update the spec in the repo: `integrations/marketplace/README.md` and add a quick test vector.
Marta (partnerships): Ok team — timeline? Can we have sandbox replay + feature flag enabled today and a reconciliation report tomorrow morning?
Samir (platform): I'll aim to have feature-flag rollout to sandbox within 6 hours.
Julia (billing): I'll have the customer list + thresholds by EOD.
Raghav (si): I'll request replays and attach partner responses to the spreadsheet.
Marta (partnerships): Perfect. Once we have sandbox results we'll decide whether to auto-backfill or raise for manual adjustments. Keep slack updates here. :+1:
